offering_description.value: Owns, operates, manages and licenses upscale restaurants, bars and lounges, including steakhouse and casual dining brands. Serves diners and event guests, and also runs food and beverage operations in hotels and other venues under management and license agreements.

primary_services.value: restaurant dining; bar and lounge service; catering and events; hotel food and beverage management

customer_segment.value: B2C: restaurant and bar guests, diners, and event attendees; B2B: hotel owners and licensees, corporate event and private dining clients

end_markets.value: restaurants; hospitality; hotels; entertainment and events

revenue_model.value: service fees: food and beverage sales at owned restaurants and bars; commissions or management fees: fees for managing hotel food and beverage operations; licensing or royalties: license and royalty fees from licensed and franchised restaurants
revenue_model.category: service fees; commissions or management fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: operates owned restaurants and bars, buying food and beverages for diners; brand owner: owns restaurant brands licensed or managed for hotel and venue partners

geography_served.value: global: US restaurants plus managed and licensed venues in Europe, the Middle East and other international locations

specialization.value: related lines: upscale steakhouses, casual restaurants, and hospitality management and licensing

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned restaurants and bars; partners / resellers: licensed and managed venues in hotels and other properties; online: online reservations, takeout and delivery ordering

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety and health codes, alcohol licensing, and labor rules

notes: Meals are served in restaurants, so products are marked not applicable; brand mix and footprint are approximate.
